|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB5-65-Ambush-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-65-Ambush.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-ambush-pre.gif]]) show the original text; see [[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Use 1 Force to deploy up to two clones from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your clones occupy three related battlegrounds during your control phase, use 2 Force (free if at Coruscant) to retrieve any one card into hand. OR If your clone in battle, add one battle destiny.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The slip prints the deploy icon (▼); the wiki writes it out (“deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”), as the card list does. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Ambush (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “free if at Coruscant” to “free if on Coruscant”. PC-E1 text: “Use 1 Force to deploy up to two clones from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If your clones occupy three related battlegrounds during your control phase, use 2 Force (free if on Coruscant) to retrieve any one card into hand. OR If your clone in battle, add one battle destiny.”<ref name="cl-1250_65-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
